subtasks.description: Align queue names and worker subscriptions explicitly; add a real broker-to-worker smoke test.
subtasks.progress_note: Queue contract: PROCESSING_QUEUE is the routed queue, the declared task_queues entry and the worker default (backend/celery_app); Makefile and infra/compose worker commands pass --queues processing; stale routes removed. Regression tests incl. an in-process broker-to-worker smoke test (memory transport, Redis variant when TEST_REDIS_URL is set) that times out with the old configuration. Verified locally (104 passed on PostgreSQL). Redis-backed variant not yet observed locally or in remote CI. Product commit 1a25b861.

subtasks.description: Commit job and outbox event atomically, then publish with retry and acknowledgement tracking.
subtasks.progress_note: job_dispatches outbox row committed with the job (create_upload_job); dispatch_job publishes under FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and records the broker message id; exponential backoff to DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS then FAILED (visible via JobResponse.dispatch); sweep_dispatch_outbox as Celery beat task + `python -m backend.jobs.outbox`; cancel on meeting deletion; payload workspace assertion re-checked against the persisted job; at-least-once documented (ADR 0007). RLS: 'dispatch' service scope on job_dispatches only. Migration e5a7c3d9b1f2 backfills queued jobs. Verified locally: test_dispatch_outbox.py (rollback, outage/backoff/park, lost-mark redelivery without duplicate results/usage, cancellation + late delivery, mismatched payload, competing dispatchers on PostgreSQL, scope visibility) and the memory-transport worker smoke test through the outbox; 148 passed on PostgreSQL 16.15, 138+10 skipped on SQLite. Evidence label: the broker test is a Celery worker integration test on the in-memory transport (real worker thread, same process); it does not validate Redis, network transport, cross-process delivery or deployed broker durability. Not verified: Redis-backed variant (TEST_REDIS_URL unset locally; runs in CI), beat in a deployed stack. Product commit 7bc47c88. Since T04 the same outbox row is re-armed for retries and recovery (dispatch.generation).

subtasks.description: Add stage attempts/checkpoints with immutable input hashes and idempotent artifact/result writes.
Implement lease renewal, fencing tokens and a sweeper for abandoned work; reject stale worker commits.
subtasks.progress_note: Execution lease on processing_jobs (locked_by/locked_at, lease_generation fencing token, attempt_id, lease_expires_at, lease_renewed_at; RUNNING rows must carry owner + lease). Atomic claim against PostgreSQL now(); renewal (LeaseHeartbeat every JOB_LEASE_RENEW_INTERVAL_SECONDS, never past the attempt deadline) and every protected write (stage transition, results, completion, failure, usage settlement, post-success audio deletion) re-lock the row and require state/generation/owner/unexpired lease; a stale attempt reports superseded and writes nothing. Stage timeout via wait_for; Celery soft/hard time limits as last bound. Retryable failures requeue through the outbox (rearm_dispatch with generation), no broker task.retry. Recovery sweeper (backend.jobs.recovery; beat entry job-lease-recovery, CLI) discovers expired RUNNING attempts under the read-only 'recovery' RLS scope, fences the generation, records the abandoned stage, re-arms the intent or parks dead_letter (failure_code lease_expired, reservations released) when attempts are exhausted. Migration f1b6d8e4a2c7 (backfills running rows as expired; drain workers before upgrade). Verified locally: test_job_leases.py on PostgreSQL 16.15 — competing claims (one lease), renewal accepted/rejected (other owner, guessed generation, expired, deadline), heartbeat under a blocked stage, recovery + fence + re-arm + audit/stage rows, stale worker rejected for results/terminal status/failure/usage/audio deletion, resumed stale worker after recovery cannot overwrite the new attempt, old messages inert, deletion racing renewal/recovery, exhaustion -> dead_letter, stage timeout -> retry via outbox, recovery scope reads processing_jobs only and cannot write, no context leak on connection reuse; full suite 162 passed on PostgreSQL, 148 passed + 14 skipped on SQLite; migration upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade on PostgreSQL and SQLite. Not verified: Redis transport, deployed beat, hard time limit in a real Celery pool, PgBouncer. Product commit 59c8ff45.

subtasks.description: Define cancellation, retryability, deadlines, poison/dead-letter behavior and bounded retry budgets.
Make usage and downstream events idempotent even when processing is delivered more than once.
Inject worker kill, broker restart, lost acknowledgement, duplicate delivery and object-write failure; reconcile all accepted jobs.
